title: unified-rollouts: canary/shadow/A-B autorollback workflow enhancements
author: Avery Chen
release_notes: Enhances autorollback workflows for canary, shadow and A/B rollouts: more robust metric matching, quarantine probing stage, and improved observability. Non-breaking.
description:
Motivation: our current autorollback behavior for mixed-mode rollouts (canary + shadow + A/B) has gaps around transient probe failures and metric matching under noise. This PR introduces a quarantine probing stage, tighter metric quorum logic, and improved telemetry to reduce false-positive rollbacks while preserving fast safety reactions.

Summary of changes: consolidated autorollback engine refactor to support staged probing, new metric-quorum matcher (supports weighted metrics and latency/err-rate composite), quarantine stage that isolates suspect traffic for manual inspection before full rollback, and additional telemetry (per-route rollback_reason, probe_histograms, metric_match_count).

What I changed: updated the autorollback engine, rollout controller, observability hooks, and e2e tests for the new workflows. Kept backwards-compatible defaults: existing rollout specs continue to work but can opt into staged-quarantine via rollout.policy.type = "provisioned-quarantine".

Checklist:
- [x] Implement staged quarantine probing and metric-quorum matcher
- [x] Add telemetry and traces for rollback reasons
- [x] Add integration tests for canary+shadow+A/B scenarios
- [x] Update rollout controller API docs and examples
- [x] Manual QA on dedicated env + perf validation

Notes: there are small config additions for customers who use explicit metric names in rollout policies; default behavior is unchanged. See linked Linear tickets for design and test plans.
commits_summary:
1) refactor(autorollback): split engine into decision + probe runner
2) feat(rollout-controller): add quarantine probing stage + policy flag
3) feat(metrics): implement weighted metric quorum matcher
4) obs: emit rollback_reason and probe_histograms to telemetry
5) test(e2e): add canary+shadow+ab autorollback scenarios
6) docs: rollout examples and migration notes
review_conversation:
Samir: Can you explain how metric quorum weights are computed when different metrics have different cardinalities?
Avery: The matcher normalizes each metric to z-scores over a rolling baseline; weights are applied after normalization so cardinality differences are mitigated. Added comments and a unit test to validate behavior.
Elena: I saw a flake in e2e where probe timeouts occasionally spike under load — can we make the probe runner backoff more conservative?
Avery: Increased probe runner backoff and added a jitter tie-breaker; re-ran e2e and flake did not reproduce. CI shows one flaky e2e previously but passing now.
Jordan: We should ensure observability exposes the rollback_reason enum for downstream dashboards.
Avery: Added rollback_reason to telemetry schema and updated docs with example Grafana query.
Samir: Approving once CI is green and integration tests are stable.
Jordan: Approving — looks good, recommended squash merge to keep commit history clean.
notes_for_release: Customers can opt into "provisioned-quarantine" rollout policy to enable staged probing. Default rollout behavior unchanged. Recommend enabling new metrics in observability to benefit from reduced false-positive rollbacks.
manual_testing: Deployed to dedicated-staging, exercised multi-model canary + shadow flows with synthetic traffic; verified rollback_reason events emitted and quarantine stage isolation works as intended.
migration_instructions: None required for existing rollouts. To adopt quarantine stage set rollout.policy = "provisioned-quarantine" and configure metric names and weights in rollout.policy.metrics. See docs/rollouts/autorollback.md for examples.
